title: Keep generated SQL within the database compatibility level
goal: Set an explicit SQL Server provider compatibility level when SQL Server 2019 or older, or a lower configured database level, cannot support EF11's new default of 160.

selectionNotes: SQL Server 2019 or older/lower configured compatibility: set the provider level to the actual supported database level; the provider setting never upgrades the server or database.
Execution covers SQL Server2025 at database150/170, not an actual2019 or older engine.

constraints: SQL Server 2019 or older/lower configured compatibility: set the provider level to the actual supported database level; the provider setting never upgrades the server or database.
Execution covers SQL Server2025 at database150/170, not an actual2019 or older engine.
Historical .NET10 comparison is not another foundation or a supported target10 edition. EF11 requires .NET11; no EF11-on-net10 route.
No cloud/Entra authentication, migrations, throughput or GA verification is claimed.
prerequisites: Copy every file of one complete project into its own directory. Install its pinned SDK/runtime and restore locked packages online; serving this recipe remains offline.

The sample creates dbo.DispatchLoads and changes compatibility only in an empty, exclusively owned disposable playbook_ database. Never point it at production or an existing shared database. Supply PLAYBOOK_SQL_CONNECTION_STRING privately in the child process; do not log it.

The repository authoring helper reuses the authorized PIN-676 SQL container, creates/removes a unique restricted database per release, and stops the server afterwards. External users must arrange their own isolated test database.
stabilityLimitations: Stable API contract prepared using .NET11 RC2 SDK/runtime/EF packages; no experimental opt-in. Actual GA reconciliation remains outstanding.
